explain.title: How to read today's numbers
explain.formula: Left = TDEE − deficit + movement above the factor − eaten so far

target.title: Eating target
target.body: Your calorie allowance for the day: your TDEE (BMR times the factor of your activity level, which already includes daily movement and the effect of eating) less the deficit for your target weight. Measured movement beyond your factor is added separately.

clamped.lose: This target is worked out with a deficit of at most 1,000 kcal a day. Your target date asks for more than that, so you get there around {{date}}.
clamped.gain: This target is worked out with a safe gaining pace. Your target date asks for faster than that, so you get there around {{date}}.
clamped.passedLose: Your target date has passed, so this target uses a safe deficit of at most 1,000 kcal a day. At that pace you get there around {{date}}.
clamped.passedGain: Your target date has passed, so this target uses a safe gaining pace. At that pace you get there around {{date}}.

eaten.title: Eaten so far
eaten.body: All the food and drinks you logged today.

left.title: Left
left.body: What still fits until tonight. Once you go past it, the number turns into Over. No stress, start again tomorrow.

burn.title: Activity today
burn.body: The movement that was really measured today: active energy from your watch (or Health Connect / Apple Health) plus logged workouts that are not on the watch. Only the part beyond the movement already in your factor counts, and {{pct}}% of that extra is added to what you can still eat.

addBack.title: Counted activity
addBack.body: Measured movement today is {{active}} kcal; {{included}} kcal is already in your level's factor, so the extra is {{extra}} kcal. {{pct}}% ({{kcal}} kcal) is added to your allowance.
addBack.watch: Active energy from your watch is {{kcal}} kcal; the watch's workouts are inside it and are not counted twice.
addBack.healthStore: Active energy from {{source}} is {{kcal}} kcal; workouts there are included.
addBack.other: Workouts outside the watch (manual, Strava) add {{kcal}} kcal.
addBack.capped: The daily cap of {{cap}} kcal was reached.
addBack.off: This is turned off in Profile, so activity does not add to what is left. What is left comes from the base target only.
addBack.none: No measured movement today. Your target already contains the average daily movement of your level.
addBack.setting: Change it in Profile > Target & body
addBack.below: Measured movement today ({{active}} kcal) has not passed the {{included}} kcal already in your level's factor, so nothing is added. Low movement never lowers your target.

deficit.title: What does deficit mean?
deficit.body: A deficit is the gap between the calories your body needs and the calories you eat. That gap is what lowers your weight. You don't have to calculate it, just eat around your target. Your plan is about {{kcal}} kcal a day.
deficit.bodyMaintenance: Your plan is to hold your weight right now, so there is no deficit. Just eat around your target.

macros.title: Macro targets
macros.intro: Protein comes from your body weight, then fat and carbs are split from today's eating target. Every number is an estimate, not a medical prescription.
macros.protein: Protein {{g}} g: 1.5 g per kg of body weight, 1.6 g on workout days. The weight used is capped at the top of the healthy range for your height.
macros.proteinGain: Protein {{g}} g: 1.8 g per kg of body weight for weight gain. The weight used is capped at the top of the healthy range for your height.
macros.fat: Fat {{g}} g: 25% of the eating target, at least 0.5 g per kg of body weight.
macros.carbs: Carbs {{g}} g: the calories left after protein and fat (4 kcal per gram).
macros.fiber: Fibre {{g}} g: 14 g per 1,000 kcal, at least 25 g.
macros.over: Once you pass a target, its bar and number turn terracotta. It's a signal, not a ban.
macros.overGain: When gaining weight, eating past these numbers is fine, so the bars don't change colour.
